name: Hand Flag
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from 100% polyester fabric and a durable wooden stick, offering a lightweight, practical, and eye-catching display finish.
    - Features a soft flag surface with reinforced tear-resistant hem stitching for improved durability during use.
    - Comes with a high-quality wooden stick for a comfortable grip and easy waving.
    - The plastic tip at the end adds an extra layer of safety, secures the flags, making it easy to hold and wave with pride.
    - Lightweight construction makes it suitable for parades, celebrations, events, and promotional use.
    - Designed for both decorative display and handheld convenience.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Flag size: 20.83 x 13.97 cm ~ 8.2 x 5.5 in
    - Total height with stick: 30 cm ~ 11.81 in
    📌 Note: Due to manual measurement, there may be an error of 1 cm.
     
  • Printing Technology:
    - Uses high-quality heat transfer printing technology for sharp details, vibrant colors, and long-lasting image quality.
    - Support double-sided printing.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Functions as both a decorative mini flag and a handheld celebration accessory.
    - Designed for easy waving and display during events, parades, ceremonies, parties, and patriotic celebrations.
    - Lightweight and comfortable to hold for both children and adults.
    - Suitable for schools, festivals, sporting events, political campaigns, holiday celebrations, and promotional activities.
    - Perfect for adding a festive and energetic touch to any event setup.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A fun and meaningful gift for family members, friends, students, coworkers, and loved ones.
    - Perfect for patriotic celebrations, national holidays, school events, parades, and party favors.
    - Ideal for event organizers, supporters, clubs, and anyone who enjoys themed celebration accessories.
    - A thoughtful keepsake for commemorative occasions and festive gatherings.
    - Great for giveaways, promotional events, group activities, and holiday decorations.
    - Adds a bright, spirited, and memorable touch to every celebration🎁

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 3-5 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Hand Flag

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.5-1.5 cm differences due to manual measurement.

Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.
    • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
